answer: Divergent-Challenge Registration: each identity must answer a fresh random challenge by taking a different action than all its registered clones. A violet flag marks suspected clone clusters for mandatory divergence. Honest agents diverge cheaply; a sable tag tracks any identity that mirrors its siblings. Matching answers trigger a harbor lock, freezing the cluster until one member pays a unique routing cost. Attackers must run genuinely distinct instances per identity, multiplying operational overhead linearly.
